SCHEMA_MISMATCH.title: Data format issue
SCHEMA_MISMATCH.what_happened: The system received data in a shape it didn't expect, so it stopped before doing anything unsafe.
what_to_try: Try again — this is usually a one-off.
If it repeats, contact support with the reference ID below.

TIMEOUT.title: Request timed out
TIMEOUT.what_happened: The request took too long and was stopped.

DEPENDENCY_DOWN.title: A service is unavailable
DEPENDENCY_DOWN.what_happened: A service AUREM depends on isn't responding right now.
what_to_try: Wait a minute and try again.

PERMISSION_DENIED.title: Not allowed
PERMISSION_DENIED.what_happened: You don't have permission to do that.
what_to_try: Check that you have the right access, or contact your admin.

VERIFY_FAILED.title: Couldn't verify the result
VERIFY_FAILED.what_happened: The change was attempted but could not be confirmed.
what_to_try: Re-run the task — it will re-verify.
Check the repo directly if this repeats.

CONTEXT_LEAK.title: Something looked out of place
CONTEXT_LEAK.what_happened: The system caught an internal inconsistency and stopped rather than risk a wrong answer.
what_to_try: Try again with a fresh session.

INTERNAL_UNKNOWN.title: Something went wrong
what_to_try: Contact support with the reference ID below if it persists.

FILE_BINARY_NOT_EDITABLE.title: Binary file — can't edit
FILE_BINARY_NOT_EDITABLE.what_happened: This file is binary (an image, archive, or other non-text format), so it can't be safely read as text or rewritten.
what_to_try: Edit binary files directly (they're skipped, not modified).
Ask for changes to text files only.

FILE_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED.title: Unsupported text encoding
FILE_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED.what_happened: This file's text encoding isn't UTF-8, so it can't be safely read and rewritten without risking corruption.
what_to_try: Re-save the file as UTF-8, or ask for changes to other files.

FILE_LANGUAGE_UNVERIFIED.title: No real check ran on this file
FILE_LANGUAGE_UNVERIFIED.what_happened: This file's language isn't one AUREM can run a real lint/type check on yet, so the edit was made but not independently verified.
what_to_try: Ask for changes to Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript files for automatic verification.
